final:
title_of(html: str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() <= html.char_count()
  ex title_of("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") == "Hello"
  ex title_of("<html><body>no title</body></html>") == ""
  ex title_of("") == ""
  let parts = html.split("<title>")
  if parts.len() < 2
    return ""
  let after = copy parts[1]
  let inner = after.split("</title>")
  if inner.len() < 2
    return ""
  copy inner[0]
